title: Roman Numeral Converter
description: Convert numbers from 1 to 3999 into Roman numerals and parse standard Roman numerals back to integers. Runs locally. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Turn an integer into a standard Roman numeral, or paste a numeral such as MCMXCIV and get the integer. Subtractive pairs are validated.
blurb: Convert between integers and standard Roman numerals in the browser.
howItWorks: Enter an integer from 1 to 3999, or a Roman numeral using I, V, X, L, C, D and M.
Choose a direction and press Convert.
Invalid repeats and non-standard subtractive pairs are rejected.
examples: IIII is rejected because four repeats are not standard.
